# iaas_microvm_secret (Resource)

Manages an account sandbox environment secret or registry credential. Requires OpenTofu 1.11 or newer (write-only arguments). Values never enter state and cannot be recovered. Increment value_version to rotate value; changing value alone does not schedule an update. Running sandboxes keep their original copy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "sandbox_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "iaas_microvm_secret" "agent" {
  name          = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
  value         = var.sandbox_secret
  value_version = 1 # Increment when supplying a new value.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique account environment variable name.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `kind` (String) env (default) or registry. Immutable.
- `registry` (String) Required for registry credentials, absent for env. Use a normalized host:port; Docker Hub aliases must be written as docker.io. Changes are refused while a kit references the credential.
- `username` (String) Required for registry credentials, absent for env; can be rotated.
- `value` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only value, required at creation or when value_version changes. Whitespace is significant. Never stored in state.
- `value_version` (Number) Increment to rotate value. Nonsecret rotation trigger, default 1.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Secret UUID. Import supported by UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import reads metadata only. Supply value only when creating or rotating.
terraform import iaas_microvm_secret.agent 6b0c2a51-0e1f-4d1c-9a47-2f7f0b6d9c11
```
